mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN upa.plan_key = 'STANDARD' THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE upa.plan_key END AS plan_key, upa.status, upa.period_start::date AS period_start, upa.period_end::date AS period_end, pe.watermark_required, pe.max_video_quality, pe.max_longform_exports_month, pe.max_short_exports_month, pe.max_concurrent_expensive_jobs, pe.feature_flags_json::text AS feature_flags_json, COALESCE(uw.longform_exports, 0) AS longform_exports, COALESCE(uw.short_exports, 0) AS short_exports, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quota_reservations qr WHERE qr.user_id = upa.user_id AND qr.status = 'RESERVED'), 0)::integer AS active_reserved_jobs FROM user_plan_assignments upa JOIN plan_entitlements pe ON pe.plan_key = CASE WHEN upa.plan_key = 'STANDARD' THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE upa.plan_key END AND pe.version = CASE WHEN upa.plan_key = 'STANDARD' THEN 1 ELSE upa.entitlement_version END LEFT JOIN usage_windows uw ON uw.user_id = upa.user_id AND uw.period_key = #{periodKey} WHERE upa.user_id = #{userId} AND upa.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (upa.period_start IS NULL OR upa.period_start <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (upa.period_end IS NULL OR upa.period_end >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY pe.active_from DESC, pe.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN upa.plan_key = 'STANDARD' THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE upa.plan_key END AS plan_key FROM user_plan_assignments upa JOIN plan_entitlements pe ON pe.plan_key = CASE WHEN upa.plan_key = 'STANDARD' THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE upa.plan_key END AND pe.version = CASE WHEN upa.plan_key = 'STANDARD' THEN 1 ELSE upa.entitlement_version END WHERE upa.user_id = #{userId} AND upa.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (upa.period_start IS NULL OR upa.period_start <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (upa.period_end IS NULL OR upa.period_end >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY pe.active_from DESC, pe.id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE OF upa
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO usage_windows (user_id, period_key) VALUES (#{userId}, #{periodKey}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, period_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM quota_reservations WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'RESERVED'
INSERT INTO quota_reservations (user_id, period_key, quota_kind, units, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{periodKey}, #{quotaKind}, #{units}, 'RESERVED') RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE quota_reservations SET generation_job_id = #{generationJobId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'RESERVED' AND (generation_job_id IS NULL OR generation_job_id = #{generationJobId})

WITH consumed AS ( UPDATE quota_reservations SET status = 'CONSUMED', finalized_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE generation_job_id = #{generationJobId} AND status = 'RESERVED' RETURNING user_id, period_key, quota_kind, units ), settled AS ( SELECT user_id, period_key, SUM(CASE WHEN quota_kind = 'LONGFORM_EXPORT' THEN units ELSE 0 END)::integer AS longform_units FROM consumed GROUP BY user_id, period_key ) UPDATE usage_windows uw SET longform_exports = uw.longform_exports + settled.longform_units, row_version = uw.row_version + 1 FROM settled WHERE uw.user_id = settled.user_id AND uw.period_key = settled.period_key

UPDATE quota_reservations SET status = 'RELEASED', finalized_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE generation_job_id = #{generationJobId} AND status = 'RESERVED'
